title: Exploring the Effect of Hydrocarbon Cross-Linkers on the Structure and Binding of Stapled p53 Peptides.
authors: Choudhury, Asha Rani; Gaikwad, Vikram; Maity, Atanu; Chakrabarti, Rajarshi
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和T-REMD模拟研究烃类交联剂对p53订书肽结构及与MDM2结合的影响，属蛋白-蛋白互作体系，非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移但对象不匹配。
abstract: Short-length peptides are used as therapeutics due to their high target specificity and low toxicity; for example, peptides are designed for targeting the interaction between oncogenic protein p53 and E3 ubiquitin ligase MDM2. These peptide therapeutics form a class of successful inhibitors. To design such peptide-based inhibitors, stapling is one of the methods in which amino acid side chains are stitched together to get conformationally rigid peptides, ensuring effective binding to their partners. In the current work, we use computer simulations to investigate p53 peptides stapled with hydrocarbon chains of different lengths and positions of attachment to the peptide. We subsequently analyze their binding efficiency with MDM2. The introduction of stapling agents restricts the conformational dynamics of peptides, resulting in higher persistence of helicity. The efficiency of the stapling agents has also been verified imposing these stapled peptides to adverse conditions viz. thermal and chemical denaturation. In addition, the conformational exploration of peptides has been investigated using temperature replica exchange molecular dynamics (T-REMD) simulations. From both the unbiased and T-REMD simulations, p53 with a long hydrocarbon cross-linker shows a more conformationally rigid structure having high helicity compared to other stapled peptides. The rigidity gained due to cross-linking reduces the entropy of the peptide in the free state and thereby facilitates the complexation process. From the binding studies, we have shown that the peptide having multiple short staples has a larger enthalpy change during binding, resulting from its orientation and interactions with residues in the binding interface. On the other hand, a peptide with a single long stapling agent shows less entropic penalty than other systems. Our study suggests a plausible rationale for the relation between the length and the position of attachment of cross-linkers to peptides and their binding affinity for target partners.
abstract_zh: 短链肽因其高靶点特异性和低毒性而被用作治疗药物；例如，设计肽用于靶向致癌蛋白p53与E3泛素连接酶MDM2之间的相互作用。这些肽类治疗药物构成了一类成功的抑制剂。为了设计此类基于肽的抑制剂，装订（stapling）是其中一种方法，通过将氨基酸侧链缝合在一起以获得构象刚性的肽，确保与其伙伴的有效结合。在当前工作中，我们使用计算机模拟来研究p53肽，这些肽被不同长度和连接位置的烃链装订。随后，我们分析它们与MDM2的结合效率。装订剂的引入限制了肽的构象动力学，导致螺旋性持久性更高。装订剂的效率也已通过在不利条件下（即热变性和化学变性）施加这些装订肽得到验证。此外，肽的构象探索已通过温度副本交换分子动力学（T-REMD）模拟进行研究。从无偏和T-REMD模拟中，与其他装订肽相比，具有长烃交联剂的p53显示出更构象刚性的结构，具有高螺旋性。交联带来的刚性降低了肽在自由状态下的熵，从而促进了复合过程。从结合研究中，我们表明具有多个短装订的肽在结合过程中具有更大的焓变，这源于其取向以及与结合界面残基的相互作用。另一方面，具有单一长装订剂的肽显示出比其他系统更小的熵惩罚。我们的研究为交联剂长度和连接位置与肽对靶标伙伴结合亲和力之间的关系提供了合理的解释。
